dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: There has to be something wrong with the way the Guild rated this commission's difficulty...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not going back to the Guild yet?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Oh, hey, it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Taisuke's been really taken with that talking cat named Neko. He insists that we continue investigating for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I'm just here to make sure that he doesn't do anything idiotic in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: And I'm also taking this opportunity to slack off for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Goodbye, and safe travels!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you not like Neko?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I don't think I'd put it in those terms. I've just got no interest in her.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I came to this island to get this commission done.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I've never been very interested in much other than that.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: The way I see it, if you get too invested in things outside the remit of your commission while you're doing it, you'll veer off onto a branching path...

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: And I wouldn't call that a good thing for a professional adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, isn't the commission complete?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Yes. Which is why I'm over here slacking off in the Guild's name, see?

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I wouldn't dare hang around here doing nothing otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, though, this place is still very concerning.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: "Asase Shrine," "Hibiki"... and of course, "Domeki."

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: I just feel that many heretofore undiscovered secrets still lie buried here on Seirai Island.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: That said... Heh, I'm too lazy to figure them all out myself.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: Once we get back to the Guild, I'll settle those reports, and we'll leave it to them to figure out a larger schema for exploring Seirai Island.

dialogues.speaker: Etsuko
dialogues.text: But before that... let me just slack here for a while more.
